verse.verse_1: We have indeed sent down the Qur’an in the Night of Destiny.
verse.verse_2: And what have you understood, what the Night of Destiny is!
verse.verse_3: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: In it descend the angels and Jibreel, by the command of their Lord – for all works.
verse.verse_5: It is peace until the rising of dawn.
